name: Bundle of relics and mystic crystal
shortDescription: A bundled assembly of recovered relics and a crystal in original interpretive design. It signifies the spell’s ingredients, not an artifact inventory verified by independent sources.
body: A bundled assembly of recovered relics and a crystal in original interpretive design. It signifies the spell’s ingredients, not an artifact inventory verified by independent sources. Original interpretive art, not official game art or evidence of canonical appearance. See the visual ledger for comparison limits.
